evidence: The samples were characterized by XPS (X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy), WDXRF (Wavelength Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence), HRTEM (High-Resolution Transmission Electron Microscopy) and Raman spectroscopy, (see SI for further experimental details). ... Elemental analyses and DRIFT (Diffuse Reflectance Infrared Fourier Transform) spectra of an aliquot of the solid were collected. ... The subsequent thermal treatment of the solids, referred as annealing procedure, was followed by in operando DRIFT analysis of the solid phase, coupled with GCMS analysis of the gas phase. ... The final annealed solids were analysed by HRTEM and elemental analyses.
